expectations.name: all-auto-commits-separately
expected_behavior: Asks no question and fixes in the same turn: it has nothing to ask
Makes three commits, one per finding, staging files by path rather than with `git add -A` or `git add .`
Runs `go test` or `go vet` in the same command that commits
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and carry no Co-Authored-By trailer
The tree ends fixed: `resp.Body.Close()` is deferred before the status check, `recieve` is gone, `trimAll` is gone
Ends with a terse report saying 3 of 3 were fixed, with no Deferred section

expectations.name: contract-asked-up-front
expected_behavior: Before editing anything, asks one round naming #1 (the `Do` signature) and #3 (the `MaxRetries` default)
Does not put #2, a plain bug fix, in the question round
Edits no file and makes no commit before the round is answered

expectations.name: answered-round-then-unattended
expected_behavior: Commits the #1 rename, and only it
Leaves `Options.Legacy` in `options.go` as the user asked
The report names #2 as not fixed, with the user's decision as the reason
